text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following the recent press conference, 
word spread that Sweep Tosho was the 
leading star of the Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other Umamusume on the Triple Tiara 
path seemed inspired by Sweep Tosho as 
well. Declarations of war came flying in 
one after another.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And watching the excitement build is Zenno 
Rob Roy— With that, the curtains rise on 
the race.
